premises: TiVNbTa RHEA is initially a single-phase solid solution
Thermal aging at 700°C causes phase segregation (α-Ti precipitates)
Phase segregation depletes solute interstitials (O, N) from the matrix
Depletion of interstitials reduces solid solution strengthening
Reduced strengthening leads to softening (reduced hardness/toughness)
